# Issue 3927 repro command.
#
# As filed (see cmd-as-filed.txt):  -T ps_6_0 -spirv test.hlsl -Fo test.spv
#
# One deviation: -Fo is dropped. With -Fo the module is written to a binary file the
# predicate cannot read; without it dxc disassembles the same module to stdout, which is
# exactly what the reporter inspected by running `spirv-dis test.spv`. Codegen is identical --
# -Fo only selects the output sink. No other flag was added or removed: the reporter filed no
# -fcgl and no -Vd, so optimisation and validation both run, at the default optimisation
# level the reporter used.
-T ps_6_0 -spirv repro.hlsl
